headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). DO NOT use Inter or generic sans. Represents authority and clarity.

body.usage: Highly legible for dense data. Use tabular-nums for all numbers. Represents technical precision.

colors.rules: No gradients. Colors are purely functional. Monochrome base with high-contrast accent colors for data points and actions.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Sharp edges, 0px border-radius.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense spacing (p-2, p-4). Containers must have borders and exact padding to avoid text collision.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6. gap-px bg-border (to create 1px grid lines).
grids_and_layouts.header: Solid white background, bottom border 1px solid. Sticky top. MUST include taxonomy version badge.

components.cards: rounded-none, border border-border, shadow-none. Brutalist/Swiss style.
components.tables: Sticky headers, sticky first column, right-aligned numbers. Use tabular-nums. No zebra striping, use border-b. Compact rows (py-2).
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), solid background, high contrast text.
components.badges: Sharp corners, subtle 1px border. Taxonomy version badge must be prominent.
components.filters: Inline, compact select dropdowns in a dedicated sticky toolbar below the header.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Minimalist axes, no grid lines or very subtle. Use exact data points, no smoothing. Solid colors.
components.empty_data: If a field is missing, display 'Sem dado' in monospace, text-muted-foreground, with a hatched background or simple subtle badge.

motion.transitions: Instant or very fast (100ms) opacity/color changes. No bouncy animations. Serious tone.
motion.hover: Text color darkens or background gets a subtle tint. No lifting or scaling.

critical_rules.no_inference: Never invent/infer/estimate data. Always show 'Sem dado' for missing fields.
critical_rules.aggregations: Only use sum, count, simple average, percentage, sort, filter. Label as 'Calculado pelo Dashboard'.
critical_rules.taxonomy_badge: Taxonomy version (e.g., 'Taxonomia Sapiens v0.8 (Experimental)') MUST be visible in the header at all times.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: This is a pedagogical observability tool. DO NOT add any gamification, no emojis, no playful colors.
Implement 5 main views (MVP): Turma, Processo Cognitivo, Aluno, Evolução, Taxonomia. Use Shadcn Tabs or Sidebar.
The 'Taxonomia' view should be a navigable tree component.
Include global filters: turma, período, disciplina, ano escolar, banca, prova.
Add a file upload area for importing JSON data.
Include CSV export functionality for tables.
Ensure the UI is in Portuguese (Brazil).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts to achieve the 'border-collapse' technical look. Avoid Shadcn Card default rounded styles.
Override Shadcn components to have `rounded-none` and remove shadows to match the Swiss archetype.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align the app container. Text must flow naturally.
Ensure proper z-index for dropdowns, modals, and sticky headers. No transparent backgrounds on overlays.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements.
